sloka: दश आभाग गतो हीनः त्वम् राम सह लक्ष्मणः ।यत् कृते व्यसनम् प्राप्तम् त्वया दार प्रधर्षणम् ॥३-७२-९॥
transliteration: daśa ābhāga gato hīnaḥ tvam rāma saha lakṣmaṇaḥ ।yat kṛte vyasanam prāptam tvayā dāra pradharṣaṇam ॥3-72-9॥

translations.english: Along with Lakshmna you are passing through a bad period on account of which your wife has been kidnapped and you, lying low, are experiencing great grief, O Rama
